note: Candidate draft produced by Agent 11, not by a Pidgin speaker. D-P1 notes that Nigerian Pidgin has no single agreed written standard, so a house style has to be chosen by a named reviewer rather than assumed by a drafter. Until that reviewer is named and recorded here, Pidgin is not offered.

passthroughRationale.app.name: Product name. It is spelled the same in every locale.
passthroughRationale.tokens.sample.text: A typographic specimen, not prose. It already mixes Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo glyphs on purpose, and translating it would destroy what it tests.
passthroughRationale.tokens.sample.arabic: An Arabic script specimen shown to prove the Arabic webfont renders. Translating it would defeat the point.
passthroughRationale.theme.dark: Pidgin is English-lexified; "Dark" is the ordinary Pidgin word for the dark theme.
passthroughRationale.tokens.page.title: "Design tokens" is a borrowed technical term used as-is.
passthroughRationale.tokens.section.colour: Technical heading on a developer-facing page; borrowed as-is.
passthroughRationale.tokens.motion.easing: Technical term of art; borrowed as-is.
passthroughRationale.tokens.anchor: Technical term of art; borrowed as-is.
passthroughRationale.tokens.chart.series: Technical term of art; borrowed as-is.
passthroughRationale.tokens.scale.count: CLDR gives Pidgin the same one/other plural shape as English, and the counted noun is the same English-lexified word, so the message is identical. Declared rather than silently forgiven.
